entities.summary: The Rock Records Co., Ltd. commonly known as Rock Records, is a record label based in Taipei, Taiwan. Founded in the 1980s as the Rock Music Publishing by Tuan Chung-tan and Tuan Chung-i, It is the largest record label in Chinese-speaking world and the second largest independent record label in Asia.
